content:
Excel workbook generation failed due to invalid formula references resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 in the 'Task' worksheet returned '#NAME?' instead of the expected numeric statistical values (e.g., H46 expected -1.5187952898550745). This indicates that the generated Excel formulas use undefined names, missing functions, or incorrect syntax that openpyxl or the verifier cannot resolve. While basic sheet structure and lookup blocks passed, the derived statistics matrix is broken.
